The '''Defence of Drogheda''' was a military engagement at the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]]<ref name="TEGtW" /> [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="CSWEHarlech">{{CSWECite|III|19|Harlech, Captain}}</ref> [[Drogheda/Legends|Drogheda]] in [[13,649 BBY]], as part of the [[Fourth Alsakan Conflict|fourth]] of the [[Alsakan Conflicts/Legends|Alsakan Conflicts]] between the planets [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], [[Alsakan/Legends|Alsakan]] and their respective allies.<ref name="TEGtW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Defence of Drogheda was mentioned in [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]]'s ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', published in [[2012]].<ref name="TEGtW" />
